entities.summary: Aurora Correa was a Spanish-born teacher and writer, a naturalized Mexican who was part of the group of exiles known as the Children of Morelia, which arrived in Mexico during the Spanish Civil War. In her 2008 book Cerezas, she narrates her experiences through the journey and exile.
